cves.description: In affected versions of Octopus Server, a user holding the System Manager role could escalate their privileges to full system Administrator.
cves.fix_suggestion:
📦 受影响组件：Octopus Deploy Octopus Server
🔓 漏洞类型：Improper Privilege Management (CWE-269)
📊 官方评级：HIGH (CVSS 8.5)
🛠️ 修复建议：
1. 确认受影响的版本范围（见上方 Affected Products）
2. 升级到厂商官方发布的最稳定安全版本
3. 检查官方安全公告获取补丁链接
4. 如无法立即升级，实施临时缓解措施：
   - 网络层：WAF 规则 / IPS 签名 / 零信任策略
   - 主机层：最小化暴露面 / 禁用危险功能 / 输入过滤
5. 修复后使用 NVD / 厂商 PoC 验证修复有效性

cves.description: In affected versions of Octopus Server, creating a user invitation writes the invitation code to the audit event log. When the invitation is linked to a space, a user in that space with appropriate permissions could read the code from the audit event. Successfully exploiting this by redeeming the unclaimed invitation could allow the user to escalate privileges however this is dependant on the permissions assigned for the invited user.
